name: lsp-intelligence
description: Query local language servers from any Codex CLI workspace with isolated mcpls backends, explicit diagnostic state, and preview-only refactorings.

interface.longDescription: Use local language servers for definitions, references, hover, symbols, diagnostics, and proposed code actions. A global plugin isolates each authorized project and language profile. Dependencies are installed explicitly from upstream.
defaultPrompt: Find this symbol and its references using the current workspace.
Check diagnostics after my edit and explain their freshness.
